L201:     This toolbox contains several scripts and functions in Python, to unmix hyperspectral data using the Extended Linear Mixing Model (ELMM) and some variants
L202: 
L203:     Details about the ELMM can be found here:
L204: 
L205:     L. Drumetz, M. Veganzones, S. Henrot, R. Phlypo, J. Chanussot and C. Jutten,
L206:     "Blind Hyperspectral Unmixing Using an Extended Linear Mixing Model to Address
L207:     Spectral Variability," in IEEE Transactions on Image Processing, vol. 25,
L208:     no. 8, pp. 3890-3905, Aug. 2016.
L209:     doi: 10.1109/TIP.2016.2579259
L210: 
L211:     And more theoretical motivation for the model can be found here:
L212: 
L213:     L. Drumetz, J. Chanussot, C. Jutten, W. Ma and A. Iwasaki, "Spectral
L214:     Variability Aware Blind Hyperspectral Image Unmixing Based on Convex Geometry,"
L215:     in IEEE Transactions on Image Processing, vol. 29, pp. 4568-4582, 2020.
L216:     doi: 10.1109/TIP.2020.2974062
L217: 
L218:     Physical motivation of the model can be found here:
L219:     L. Drumetz, J. Chanussot and C. Jutten, "Spectral Unmixing: A Derivation of the Extended Linear Mixing Model From the Hapke Model," in IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters.
L220:     doi: 10.1109/LGRS.2019.2958203
L221: 
L222:     And its ability to account for nonlinear mixing phenomena to some extent can be found here:
L223:     L. Drumetz, B. Ehsandoust, J. Chanussot, B. Rivet, M. Babaie-Zadeh and C. Jutten, "Relationships Between Nonlinear and Space-Variant Linear Models in Hyperspectral Image Unmixing," in IEEE Signal Processing Letters, vol. 24, no. 10, pp. 1567-1571, Oct. 2017.
L224:     doi: 10.1109/LSP.2017.2747478
L225: 
L226:     The contents include:
L227: 
L228:     - ELMM.py: Function performing the unmixing with the ELMM
L229:     - RELMM.py: Function performing the unmixing with the Robust version of the ELMM
L230:     - demo_ELMM.py: example of use of the algorithms on a real hyperspectral dataset
L231:     - real_data_1.mat: real dataset used (crop of the DFC 2013 data)
L232:     - endmembers_houston.mat: reference endmember matrix used in the demo
L233:     - FCLSU.py : function performing the standard fully constrained least squared unmixing.
L234:     - SCLSU.py: function performing a scaled version of CLSU, which follows a particular case of the ELMM
L235:     - pca_viz.py: function projecting data and endmembers on the space spanned by the first three principal components of the data and displaying a scatterplot
L236:     - rescale.py: function rescaling hyperspectral data between 0 and 1
L237:     - proj_simplex.py: function projecting one or several vectors onto the unit simplex
